h1: Architectural facade solution for a villa reconstruction in Marbella, Spain

blocks.text: Architectural facade solution for a villa reconstruction in Marbella, Spain

parts.html: The architectural solution for the facade of a luxury villa in Marbella, Spain, was developed by DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) as part of a reconstruction project.

The concept focuses on transforming the existing exterior while preserving harmonious architectural proportions and creating a refined contemporary appearance. Carefully selected facade materials, sophisticated details, and balanced color combinations emphasize the character of the villa and give the building an elegant and prestigious look.

Particular attention was paid to the proportions of the facade, the interaction between architectural elements, the combination of textures and materials, and the overall visual integrity of the exterior. The result is a contemporary luxury concept that combines elegance, functionality, and timeless architectural aesthetics.

The updated appearance of the villa is presented through photorealistic 3D visualizations, making it possible to evaluate the proposed facade design, materials, colors, architectural details, and overall character of the building before reconstruction.

The visualization clearly demonstrates how the existing villa can be transformed through carefully considered architectural facade solutions while maintaining a harmonious relationship between the building and its surroundings.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) — creating architecture that inspires.
